units.source_text: 柏木卫门督昨日笼闭在家，闷得慌了，

en.t: Kashiwagi, the Captain of the Gate Guards, had shut himself up at home the day before and had grown terribly depressed.

units.source_text: 今天看见他的诸弟左大弁、头宰相等乘车前往参观贺茂祭归来的行列，

en.t: Today he saw his younger brothers, the Major Controller of the Left and the Head Chamberlain among them, setting out by carriage to watch the procession returning from the Kamo Festival.

units.source_text: 便也上车，坐在车厢里面的座位上。

en.t: So he too got into a carriage and took a seat inside.

units.source_text: 归途中听人传说紫夫人病故，吃了一惊，

en.t: On the way back, he heard people say that Lady Murasaki had died, and he was startled.

units.source_text: 独自低吟古歌中句：“君看浮世上，何物得长生？”便和诸弟一同到二条院探视。

en.t: He murmured to himself a line from an old poem: "Look at this floating world; what in it can live forever?" Then he went with his brothers to Nijo-in to inquire after her.

units.source_text: 因为消息不确，未便冒失地说来吊丧，所以只当作普通访问。

en.t: Since the news was uncertain, they did not dare say rashly that they had come to offer condolences, and treated it as an ordinary visit.

units.source_text: 然而一走进门，听见里面哭声震天，似乎确是事实，大家惊慌起来。

en.t: But as soon as they entered the gate, they heard cries inside loud enough to shake the heavens, and everyone panicked, feeling that the rumor must be true.

units.source_text: 紫夫人的父亲式部卿亲王也来了，他悲痛不堪地走进室内去，连招待访客也顾不得了。

en.t: Lady Murasaki's father, Prince Shikibukyo, had also come; overcome with grief, he went into the inner rooms and could not even attend to the visitors.

units.source_text: 夕雾大将揩着眼泪，从里面走出来。

en.t: General Yugiri came out from within, wiping away his tears.

units.source_text: 柏木忙问：“怎么样了，怎么样了？外面传说不吉，我们不敢相信。

en.t: Kashiwagi hurriedly asked, "How is she? How is she? There are ominous rumors outside, but we cannot believe them.

units.source_text: 只因听见令堂久患清恙，不胜挂念，所以前来探望。”

en.t: We only heard that your mother has long been unwell, and because we were so concerned, we came to visit."

units.source_text: 夕雾答道：“这病实在沉重得很，缠绵了好几个月了。

en.t: Yugiri replied, "Her illness has truly been very grave, and it has lingered for several months.

units.source_text: 今天早上曾经一度昏死过去，乃是鬼魂作祟。

en.t: This morning she once lost consciousness as if dead, because of the malice of a possessing spirit.

units.source_text: 听说好容易活过来了。

en.t: I hear that she finally managed to revive.

units.source_text: 现在大家已经放心，然而今后如何，正未可卜，真正教人担心呢。”

en.t: Everyone is relieved for now, but no one can tell what will happen from here on, and it is truly worrying."

units.source_text: 看他的模样，的确哭得很厉害，两眼已经有些红肿了。

en.t: From the look of him, he had certainly wept bitterly, and both his eyes were already somewhat red and swollen.

units.source_text: 大概是因为柏木自己心中怀着隐情之故，所以以己度人，

en.t: Probably because Kashiwagi himself was carrying a secret in his heart, he judged others by his own feelings.

units.source_text: 推想夕雾对于这个并不亲近的继母，何以如此关怀深切，便用疑心的眼光注视他。

en.t: He wondered why Yugiri cared so deeply for this stepmother to whom he was not especially close, and looked at him with suspicion.

units.source_text: 源氏闻知许多人前来探病，叫人传言：“病势沉重，今晨突然呈现假死之状。

en.t: When Genji learned that many people had come to ask after her illness, he sent out a message: "Her condition is grave, and this morning she suddenly appeared to be in a deathlike state.

units.source_text: 众侍女仓皇失措，奔走号哭。

en.t: The waiting women lost their heads in panic, running about and wailing aloud.

units.source_text: 我也惶惑不安，心绪缭乱。

en.t: I too am bewildered and uneasy, and my thoughts are in disorder.

units.source_text: 多蒙亲友关怀，改日再行答谢。”

en.t: I am deeply grateful for the concern of relatives and friends, and will offer my thanks properly another day."

units.source_text: 柏木心甚紊乱，若非为此不得已之事，决不会来此访问。

en.t: Kashiwagi's heart was in great turmoil; if not for this unavoidable matter, he would never have come here to visit.

units.source_text: 此时看到周围一切景象，都感到惭愧无地，因为他自己心里怀着鬼胎。

en.t: Now, seeing everything around him, he felt so ashamed he could hardly bear to be there, because he himself was harboring guilty thoughts.
